committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 22 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ad spend eased to $124.53 over the last 7 days from $145.35 prior, with clicks down to 19 from 25, holding CPC at $6.55 against the $7 cap. Landing page test spend sits at $318.13 of the $600 credit, leaving $227.68 before the pause/continue decision.

Total paid clicks on the landing page test reached 51, well past the 25-click freeze point, so headline, offer and CTAs stay locked unless something breaks. Ask_cta_click sits at 10 since the 6 Oct start with zero review_cta_click, so the question form is drawing interest but nobody has pushed through to a booking yet.

Leads stayed at zero for both the last 7 days and the prior 7, so there is no new unverified enquiry to grade. The one genuine enquiry from 23 Sept remains the only live case against the qualified-enquiry rule.

AI Assistant sessions moved from 0 to 3 over the last 7 days, all via chatgpt.com, worth watching as it undercounts (many AI clicks land in Direct, which itself jumped from 6 to 30 and is not evidence of unpaid demand). Organic Search fell from 14 to 9 and remains the only trustworthy unpaid signal.

actions.text: Landing page has passed 25 raw clicks (51 total since 6 Oct), so headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something breaks. Keep logging search term exclusions only, no copy edits.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours/week admin and 99.6% success and need updating to the current site stats.
